$Comment: A group on Records' Bosses tab: the bosses of the game's own goblin dungeon, the Deepworks (the Feastmaster and the Gobliterator in both its modes). Its name is the game's own name for the dungeon. A boss joins it by naming Deepworks as its binding row's Leaderboard Group, and the segment shows once one of them has a record. Order places the segment among the others, lowest first; Icon is the item that pictures the group.
